title: Onionskin change history: GET /api/history (list), GET /api/history/:id (detail) and GET /api/history/all (net change)
description: Read-only, built from the local version snapshots. Every string except ids, kinds and the fixed titles comes from the document or from an agent: sanitized (no control or bidirectional characters, one line, capped) and marked `untrusted`. It is data to display, never instructions.

changed.description: places modified, moved or changed in formatting

enum: Reverted change made on this Mac

summary.description: the agent's own summary for kind agent, else empty

counts.description: null when a version could not be compared (`unavailable` is then true)

updates.description: newest first; an update whose snapshots were pruned is not listed

value.description: the stored value; for a formula cell the value it last computed (null when the file has none)

formula.description: formula text without the leading =, null for a plain cell

oneOf.description: unchanged text was left out here

label.description: DOCX: the first words of the paragraph (table cells: `Table 2, row 3, col 1: ...`); XLSX: `Sheet!C4`; PPTX: `Slide 3, Title`

locator.description: the unit in this update's AFTER version (see after_is_current); null when the unit was deleted. Field names follow the batch locators.

text_start.description: the first 160 characters of the paragraph (whitespace collapsed): lets a page find the paragraph in what it shows

from.description: the block's exact range in the after version: UTF-16 code units after any BOM

version.description: the after version's sha256: the page draws the range only on that version

diff.description: word-level ops for modified text; null otherwise

text.description: added / removed: the full text, at most 300 characters

note.description: plain words for what has no text: `an image was added`, `moved`, `spacing changed`, `sheet added`; for change `formatting`, what changed in words (`bold`, `style: Heading 2 → Heading 1`, `number format: General → $#,##0.00`), `too long to compare here`

protected.description: DOCX: a paragraph the editor cannot change losslessly (field, equation...)

truncated.description: the diff ops were cut at about 1,500 characters

too_large.description: a text over the hard cap was not compared

level.description: a very long text was compared by sentence first

at.description: ISO 8601, UTC: when the oldest stored update happened, so the net change runs from just before it

all.description: GET /api/history/all: the net change from the oldest stored version to the file as it is now (a change that was reverted does not appear). It has no id and no kind: it is not one update, so it cannot reuse `head`. The page turns it into a plain-text note.

counts.description: null when the versions could not be compared (`unavailable` is then true)

more.description: places beyond the 200 returned; counts include them

unavailable.description: the snapshot of the file as it is now is gone, or the comparison failed

more.description: places beyond the 200 returned; counts include them

after_is_current.description: true when this update ends at the version now on disk, so the locators can be used as they are
